description: Source code for the FormatShaper module in Android media framework, implementing format shaping functions, shaper management, and external interface definitions.

classes.name: FormatShaperOps_t
classes.description: Structure defining operations for media format shaper, exposed externally.

methods.name: shapeFormat
methods.description: Shapes the media format based on media type, applying video or audio specific transformations.

methods.name: setMap
methods.description: Sets a mapping key-value pair for the shaper.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets a feature value for the shaper.

methods.name: setTuning
methods.description: Sets tuning parameters for the shaper.

methods.name: findShaper
methods.description: Finds and returns a shaper handle based on codec name and media type.

methods.name: createShaper
methods.description: Creates a new shaper instance for specified codec and media type.

methods.name: registerShaper
methods.description: Registers a shaper, finalizing its setup.

methods.name: getReverseMappings
methods.description: Retrieves reverse mappings for a given 'kind'.
